title: 24:18-20 who fleeth from the noise of the fear. Those who work iniquity fear the Lord's judgments and attempt to hide in the rocks and dust; they "fear . . . the Lord, and . . . the glory of his majesty" (2:19). This is in striking contrast to the command given to the Saints to "fear not, for the kingdom is yours" (D&C 38:15).
author: Tina M. Peterson
